_doc: Extra play-area parts (local metres), unioned into the polygon by pipeline/playarea.py. Oriented rect: centre, angle_deg of the d axis (x'=cos,sin), d range along it, c range across it (c axis = d rotated +90 deg).

rects.name: Zuerich HB (Haupthalle, Querhalle, Perronkopf, Bahnhofplatz-Rand)
rects.why: User 2026-10-16: HB lies ~180 m east of the old edge; Hauptgebaeude spans d -30..110, c -35..60 (research/hb/README.md); c to -150 on 2026-10-18 so the Bahnhofplatz south part with the Escher-Brunnen is inside (research/hb/review.md)

rects.name: Idaplatz-Quartier (Zurlinden-, Berta-, Zweier-, Aemtler-/Gertrudstrasse)
rects.why: User 2026-10-18: Idaplatz (OSM centre -125,-1115, NOT the 237/-1465 of places.json) lay ~197 m outside the edge; 800x800 m rect gives >=400 m around the square (Zurlindenstr., Bertastr., Zweierstr., Aemtlerstr., Gertrudstr.)
